darslar.nomi: Orqa anatomiyasi va vegetativ nerv tizimi

bandlar: Primary curves (fetal): thoracic and sacral
Secondary curves (after birth): cervical (holding head) and lumbar (walking)
Kyphosis: exaggerated thoracic curve (elderly, osteoporosis)
Lordosis: exaggerated lumbar curve (pregnancy, spondylolisthesis)
Scoliosis: lateral deviation + rotation (polio, short leg, hip disease)
postlar.izoh:
Umurtqa pog'onasining egriliklari ikki xil bo'ladi.

🔹 Birlamchi egriliklar (ko'krak va dumg'aza) homila davridayoq shakllanadi.
🔹 Ikkilamchi egriliklar tug'ilgandan keyin paydo bo'ladi: bo'yin egriligi bola boshini ko'tara boshlaganda, bel egriligi esa yura boshlaganda.

Patologiyalar:
• Kifoz - ko'krak egriligining kuchayishi (keksalarda osteoporoz tufayli 'bukchayish')
• Lordoz - bel egriligining kuchayishi (homiladorlik, spondilolistez, katta qorin)
• Skolioz - umurtqaning yonga og'ishi va buralishi (poliomiyelit, oyoqlar uzunligi farqi, son bo'g'imi kasalliklari)

bandlar: Atlanto-occipital (occiput - C1): nodding YES + lateral tilt
Atlantoaxial (C1 - C2): rotation NO
Both are synovial joints with NO intervertebral disc
Alar ligaments (dens -> foramen magnum) limit excessive rotation
postlar.izoh:
Boshning harakatlari ikki bo'g'imda bo'ladi - oson eslab qolish uchun 'HA' va 'YO'Q'.

✅ 'HA' (bosh irg'ash) - atlanto-oksipital bo'g'imda: ensa suyagi do'mboqlari bilan atlant (C1) yuqori bo'g'im yuzalari orasida. Boshni yonga egish ham shu yerda.

❌ 'YO'Q' (boshni chapga-o'ngga burish) - atlantoaksial bo'g'imda: C1 va C2 orasida. Bu yerda ikkita lateral va bitta median bo'g'im bor (C1 old ravog'i bilan C2 tishi - dens orasida).

Ikkala bo'g'im ham sinovial, ularda umurtqalararo disk YO'Q. Ortiqcha burilishni alar boylamlar cheklaydi.

bandlar: Cause: rupture of transverse ligament of atlas
Trauma (Jefferson fracture) or rheumatoid arthritis
Mobile dens compresses cervical cord or medulla
Dens held by: cruciate ligament, alar ligaments, tectorial membrane
Wide atlantodental interval = transverse ligament tear
postlar.izoh:
C2 tishi (dens) o'z joyida atlantning ko'ndalang boylami bilan ushlab turiladi. Bu boylam yirtilsa - atlantoaksial chiqish (subluksatsiya) yuzaga keladi.

Sabablari: shikast (masalan, Jefferson sinishi) yoki revmatoid artrit.

⚠️ Xavfi: harakatchan bo'lib qolgan dens bo'yin orqa miyasini (tetraplegiya) yoki uzunchoq miyani (nafas markazi - to'satdan o'lim) ezishi mumkin.

Densni ushlab turuvchi tuzilmalar:
• ko'ndalang boylam (yuqori va pastki bo'ylama tutamlar bilan birga - xochsimon boylam)
• alar boylamlar
• tektorial parda (orqa bo'ylama boylamning davomi)

💡 USMLE: revmatoid artritli bemorni intubatsiya qilishdan oldin bo'yin holatiga e'tibor!

bandlar: Spondylolysis: stress fracture of pars interarticularis
Adolescent athletes, usually L4-L5; 'collar on Scottie dog' on oblique X-ray
Spondylolisthesis: vertebral body slips ANTERIORLY on the one below
Degenerative: L4-L5; congenital: L5-S1
May follow spondylolysis; causes lordosis
postlar.izoh:
Ikki o'xshash nomli, lekin farqli holat:

🔹 Spondiloliz - pars interarticularis'ning (ravoqning oyoqcha va plastinka orasidagi qismi) charchoq sinishi. Ko'pincha o'smir sportchilarda (gimnastika, futbol), L4 yoki L5 da. Qiyshiq rentgenogrammada 'skotch-terer itining bo'ynidagi bo'yinbog'' belgisi ko'rinadi.

🔹 Spondilolistez (yunoncha 'umurtqaning sirpanishi') - umurtqa tanasining pastdagi umurtqaga nisbatan OLDINGA siljishi. Lordozni kuchaytiradi.
• Degenerativ shakli - odatda L4-L5
• Tug'ma shakli - odatda L5-S1
• Ko'pincha spondilolizning asorati bo'ladi.

bandlar: Jefferson: axial compression of head -> C1 burst at multiple sites
Jefferson: C1 lateral masses displaced beyond C2 + transverse ligament tear
Whiplash (hyperextension): neck muscle strain; severe -> anterior longitudinal ligament tear
Chance (seat belt, hyperflexion): L2-L3 transverse fracture through body and arch
Chance: posterior ligaments torn, intra-abdominal injuries common
postlar.izoh:
USMLE da sinish turi mexanizmdan topiladi:

💥 Jefferson sinishi - boshga yuqoridan kuch (masalan, sayoz suvga sho'ng'ish). C1 bir necha joydan sinadi, yon massalari C2 chegarasidan tashqariga chiqadi, ko'ndalang boylam yirtiladi.

🚗 Giperekstenziya (whiplash) - mashinaga orqadan urilganda. Ko'pincha bo'yin mushaklari cho'ziladi xolos; og'irrog'ida old bo'ylama boylam va disk old qismi yirtilib, rentgenda (masalan, C5-C6) disk oralig'i oldinda kengayadi.

🔒 Chance sinishi - 'xavfsizlik kamari jarohati', keskin bukilish. Odatda L2-L3: umurtqa tanasi va ravog'i ko'ndalang sinadi, disk, orqa bo'ylama, sariq, qirralararo va qirra usti boylamlar yirtiladi. Orqa miya odatda zararlanmaydi, lekin qorin ichi a'zolari jarohati ko'p uchraydi!

bandlar: Discs = ~25% of vertebral column length (cartilaginous joints)
Anulus fibrosus (outer fibrocartilage) + nucleus pulposus (notochord remnant)
Herniation: posterolateral (PLL is strong in midline)
Most common: L4/L5, L5/S1 and C5/C6, C6/C7
Compresses the root ONE number below: L4 disc -> L5 root
postlar.izoh:
Umurtqalararo disk umurtqa pog'onasi uzunligining chorak qismini tashkil qiladi. Disk o'zidan yuqoridagi umurtqa nomi bilan ataladi.

Tuzilishi:
• Fibroz halqa - tashqi tolali-tog'ay halqalar
• Pulpoz yadro - ichki yumshoq, elastik 'amortizator'. Bu xordaning tug'ilgandan keyingi qoldig'i (USMLE da tez-tez so'raladi!)

Disk churrasi: pulpoz yadro fibroz halqani yorib chiqadi. Odatda orqa-yon tomonga, chunki o'rtada orqa bo'ylama boylam mustahkam.

📍 Ko'p uchraydigan sathlar: L4/L5, L5/S1 va C5/C6, C6/C7.

⚡️ Asosiy qoida: churra o'zidan BITTA PASTDAGI ildizni ezadi. L4 disk -> L5 ildiz, C7 disk -> C8 ildiz. Natijada nerv bo'ylab og'riq (masalan, ishias).

bandlar: Adult spinal cord ends at L1-L2; subarachnoid space (CSF) to S2
Puncture at L3-L4 or L4-L5 (cauda equina level)
Layers: skin -> fat -> supraspinous -> interspinous -> ligamentum flavum
Epidural space: epidural anesthesia stops here
Then dura + arachnoid -> subarachnoid space (CSF)
postlar.izoh:
Kattalarda orqa miya L1-L2 sathida tugaydi, lekin subaraxnoidal bo'shliq (likvor bilan) S2 gacha davom etadi. Shuning uchun lyumbal punksiya L3-L4 yoki L4-L5 oralig'ida qilinadi - bu yerda faqat ot dumi (cauda equina) ildizlari bor, ular igna oldidan 'qochadi'.

💉 Igna o'tadigan qavatlar ketma-ketligi:
1. Teri
2. Fassiya va yog' qavati
3. Qirra usti boylami
4. Qirralararo boylam
5. Sariq boylam (ligamentum flavum) - oxirgi 'qarshilik'
6. Epidural bo'shliq - epidural anesteziyada igna shu yerda to'xtaydi
7. Qattiq va o'rgimchaksimon pardalar
8. Subaraxnoidal bo'shliq - likvor shu yerdan olinadi

bandlar: Dorsal root: sensory; DRG holds pseudounipolar cell bodies
Ventral root: motor axons from ventral/lateral horn
Dorsal rami: skin of back + deep (intrinsic) back muscles
Ventral rami: anterolateral trunk + limbs; form plexuses
31 pairs: 8C, 12T, 5L, 5S, 1Co; C1-C7 exit ABOVE, C8 and below exit BELOW their vertebra
postlar.izoh:
Orqa miya nervi ikki ildizdan hosil bo'ladi:
• Orqa ildiz - sezuvchi. Unda spinal ganglion bor, uning ichida psevdounipolyar neyronlar tanasi joylashgan.
• Old ildiz - harakatlantiruvchi. Neyron tanalari old (va yon) shoxlarda.

Ikkala ildiz qo'shilib, nerv umurtqalararo teshikdan chiqadi va shoxlarga bo'linadi:
• Orqa shoxlar - orqa terisi va orqaning chuqur (xususiy) mushaklari
• Old shoxlar - tananing old-yon qismi va qo'l-oyoqlar; yelka va bel-dumg'aza chigallarini hosil qiladi

🔢 31 juft: 8 bo'yin, 12 ko'krak, 5 bel, 5 dumg'aza, 1 dum.

⚡️ Chiqish qoidasi: C1-C7 o'z umurtqasidan YUQORIDA chiqadi (C3 - C3 umurtqa ustidan). C8 - C7 va T1 orasidan. Qolganlari o'z umurtqasidan PASTDA chiqadi (L2 - L2 ostidan).

bandlar: ANS: smooth muscle, cardiac muscle, glands; 2 neurons (pre + post)
Sympathetic = thoracolumbar: lateral horn T1-L2
Chain (paravertebral) ganglia: body wall, limbs, head (T1-2), thoracic viscera (T1-5)
Thoracic splanchnics T5-T12 -> celiac, aorticorenal, SMG: foregut + midgut
Lumbar splanchnics L1-L2 -> IMG, pelvic ganglia: hindgut + pelvis
postlar.izoh:
Vegetativ nerv tizimi silliq mushak, yurak mushagi va bezlarni boshqaradi. Har doim 2 neyron: preganglionar (tanasi MNS da) va postganglionar (tanasi periferik gangliyda).

🔴 Simpatik tizim = torakolumbal. Preganglionar neyronlar T1-L2 segmentlari yon shoxida (14 segment).

Sinaps joylari:
• Simpatik zanjir (paravertebral) gangliylari -> tana devori, qo'l-oyoqlar, bosh (T1-2) va ko'krak a'zolari (T1-5)
• Ko'krak splanxnik nervlari (T5-T12) -> prevertebral gangliylar (seliak, aortorenal, yuqori tutqich) -> oldingi va o'rta ichak
• Bel splanxnik nervlari (L1-L2) -> pastki tutqich va tos gangliylari -> orqa ichak va tos a'zolari

💡 Istisnolar: buyrak usti bezi mag'iz qismiga preganglionar tolalar BEVOSITA keladi; ter bezlari simpatik, lekin xolinergik (atsetilxolin) tolalar bilan innervatsiya qilinadi.

bandlar: Horner: Ptosis + Anhidrosis + Miosis ('PAM is Horny')
1st neuron: lateral medullary syndrome, pontine bleed, cord lesion above T1
2nd neuron: stellate ganglion compression by Pancoast tumor
3rd neuron: carotid dissection (painful), sweating usually spared
Parasympathetic = craniosacral: CN III, VII, IX, X + S2-S4 (pelvic splanchnics)
postlar.izoh:
👁 Horner sindromi - yuzning bir tomonida simpatik innervatsiya yo'qolishi:
• Ptoz (yuqori tarsal mushak falaji - qovoq biroz tushadi)
• Mioz (qorachiq torayishi)
• Angidroz (terlash va qizarishning yo'qligi)
Eslab qolish: 'PAM is Horny'.

Zararlanish sathi bo'yicha:
1️⃣ 1-neyron: uzunchoq miya lateral sindromi, Varoliy ko'prigiga qon quyilish, T1 dan yuqori orqa miya zararlanishi
2️⃣ 2-neyron: yulduzsimon gangliyni Pankost o'smasi ezishi
3️⃣ 3-neyron: uyqu arteriyasi disseksiyasi (og'riqli), angidroz odatda bo'lmaydi

🟢 Parasimpatik tizim = kraniosakral: III, VII, IX, X bosh miya nervlari va S2-S4 (tos splanxnik nervlari). Postganglionar neyronlar a'zo yonida yoki devorida. X nerv bo'yin, ko'krak, oldingi va o'rta ichakni; tos splanxniklari orqa ichak, qovuq va jinsiy a'zolarni innervatsiya qiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 74-year-old woman with long-standing osteoporosis is brought by her daughter, who notes that her mother has become progressively 'hunched over' during the past 5 years. Examination shows an exaggerated forward curvature of the upper back.
savollar.savol: Which spinal deformity is present?
savollar.izoh: Kifoz - ko'krak egriligining kuchayishi, keksalarda osteoporozdagi kompression sinishlar tufayli. Lordoz - bel egriligi, skolioz - yonga og'ish.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old woman with long-standing rheumatoid arthritis is scheduled for elective surgery. Preoperative flexion radiographs of the cervical spine show a markedly widened atlantodental interval.
savollar.savol: Damage to which structure is most likely responsible?
savollar.izoh: Atlant-tish oralig'i kengaygan = atlantning ko'ndalang boylami shikastlangan. RA da atlantoaksial subluksatsiya: dens orqa miya va uzunchoq miyani ezishi mumkin.

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old man dives into a shallow lake and strikes the top of his head on the bottom. CT of the cervical spine shows fractures of the atlas at several sites, with its lateral masses displaced beyond the margins of the axis.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Boshga yuqoridan kuch (o'q bo'ylab kompressiya) -> C1 bir necha joydan sinadi = Jefferson sinishi. Ko'pincha ko'ndalang boylam ham yirtiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 15-year-old female gymnast has 3 months of low back pain that worsens with back extension. An oblique lumbar radiograph shows a radiolucent defect resembling a 'collar' on the neck of the 'Scottie dog' at L5.
savollar.savol: Which part of the vertebra is affected?
savollar.izoh: Spondiloliz: pars interarticularis charchoq sinishi. O'smir sportchilar, L4-L5. Rentgenda 'skotch-teryer bo'ynidagi bo'yinbog''. Spondilolistezga o'tishi mumkin.

savollar.vinyetka: A 32-year-old restrained driver wearing only a lap belt is involved in a high-speed head-on collision. Radiographs show a horizontal fracture through the L2 vertebral body, pedicles and spinous process. Bruising is seen across the lower abdomen.
savollar.savol: Which associated injury must be actively ruled out?
savollar.izoh: Chance sinishi (kamar jarohati, giperfleksiya, L2-L3): orqa miya kam zararlanadi, lekin ichak va tutqich jarohatlari ko'p uchraydi - qorinni KT bilan tekshirish shart.

savollar.vinyetka: A 27-year-old woman's car is struck from behind while she is stopped at a traffic light. She has neck pain and stiffness. A lateral cervical radiograph shows widening of the anterior part of the C5-C6 intervertebral space without fracture.
savollar.savol: Which ligament is most likely torn?
savollar.izoh: Orqadan urilish -> giperekstenziya (whiplash). Og'ir holatda old bo'ylama boylam yirtiladi va disk oralig'i OLDINDA kengayadi. Sinish kam uchraydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 41-year-old man has sharp low back pain radiating down the lateral leg to the dorsum of the foot after lifting heavy boxes. He has weakness of great toe extension. MRI shows a posterolateral disc herniation at the L4-L5 level.
savollar.savol: Which nerve root is most likely compressed?
savollar.izoh: Churra pastdagi ildizni ezadi: L4-L5 disk -> L5 ildiz (bosh barmoqni ko'tarish kuchsiz, oyoq orqasida uvishish). L5-S1 bo'lsa - S1 (Axill refleksi pasayadi).

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old woman in labor requests epidural analgesia. The anesthesiologist inserts the needle in the midline at the L3-L4 interspace and feels a distinct 'loss of resistance' as the needle tip enters the epidural space.
savollar.savol: Which structure did the needle pierce immediately before entering the epidural space?
savollar.izoh: Qavatlar: teri, yog', qirra usti, qirralararo, SARIQ boylam -> epidural bo'shliq. Sariq boylamdan keyin 'qarshilik yo'qolishi' sezilib, igna shu yerda to'xtatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 63-year-old man with a 50-pack-year smoking history has shoulder pain radiating down the medial arm. His right eyelid droops slightly, his right pupil is smaller than the left, and the right side of his face does not sweat. Chest X-ray shows a right apical lung mass.
savollar.savol: Where is the sympathetic pathway most likely interrupted?
javoblar: Second-order neuron at the stellate ganglion
Third-order neuron along the internal carotid artery
savollar.izoh: Pankost o'smasi (o'pka cho'qqisi) yulduzsimon gangliyni ezadi -> 2-neyron Horner sindromi: ptoz, mioz, angidroz. Yelka og'rig'i - yelka chigali ham ezilgan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 4-year-old boy ingests several of his grandmother's anticholinergic pills. He is agitated, febrile, flushed, and his skin is hot and completely dry. Pupils are dilated.
savollar.savol: Why is sweating absent in this patient?
javoblar: Sweat glands receive sympathetic cholinergic (muscarinic) innervation
Sweat glands receive parasympathetic innervation via CN X
Sweat glands are innervated by adrenergic beta-2 fibers
Sweat glands are controlled only by circulating epinephrine
Sweat glands have nicotinic receptors blocked by the drug
savollar.izoh: Ter bezlari simpatik tizimga tegishli, lekin postganglionar tolalari atsetilxolin ajratadi (muskarin retseptorlari). Shuning uchun antixolinergik dorilar terlashni to'xtatadi.

bandlar: Modified sweat gland in superficial pectoral region; fat gives shape and size
Cooper (suspensory) ligaments: skin -> deep fascia
Internal thoracic artery (from subclavian): medial part
Lateral thoracic artery (from axillary): lateral part, runs with long thoracic nerve
Tumor pulls Cooper ligaments -> skin dimpling, 'orange peel'
postlar.izoh:
Sut bezi - ko'krak sohasidagi teri osti bezi, aslida o'zgargan ter bezi. Uning shakli va hajmini bez atrofidagi yog' to'qimasi belgilaydi.

🔹 Kuper boylamlari - bezni teriga 'osib' turuvchi boylamlar, teridan chuqur fassiyagacha boradi.

🩸 Qon bilan ta'minlanishi:
• Ichki ko'krak arteriyasi (o'mrov osti arteriyasi tarmog'i) - bezning medial qismi
• Lateral ko'krak arteriyasi (qo'ltiq arteriyasi tarmog'i) - lateral qismi. U oldingi tishli mushak ustida uzun ko'krak nervi bilan yonma-yon yuradi (keyingi postlarda bu muhim bo'ladi!)

⚠️ Klinika: o'sma Kuper boylamlarini tortib, terida botiqlik va 'apelsin po'sti' ko'rinishini keltirib chiqaradi.

bandlar: ~75% of lymph -> axillary nodes (pectoral group first)
Axillary route: nipple + superior, lateral and inferior quadrants
Medial quadrant -> parasternal nodes along internal thoracic vessels
Medial route: spread to the opposite breast
postlar.izoh:
Limfa oqimi sut bezi saratonining qayerga metastaz berishini belgilaydi, shuning uchun USMLE da muhim.

➡️ Lateral yo'l (taxminan 75%): so'rg'ich, yuqori, lateral va pastki kvadrantlardan limfa qo'ltiq limfa tugunlariga, avval pektoral guruhga boradi. Shuning uchun saratonda birinchi bo'lib qo'ltiq tugunlari tekshiriladi.

⬅️ Medial yo'l: medial kvadrantdan limfa asosan to'sh yonidagi (parasternal) tugunlarga, ichki ko'krak tomirlari bo'ylab boradi. Saraton aynan shu yo'l orqali qarama-qarshi sut beziga tarqalishi mumkin.

bandlar: Long thoracic nerve (C5-C7) -> serratus anterior
Injured while ligating lateral thoracic artery or axillary dissection
Result: winged scapula, cannot abduct arm above 90 degrees
Thoracodorsal nerve -> latissimus dorsi: weak extension + medial rotation
Also: stab wounds of lateral chest wall
postlar.izoh:
Mastektomiyada ikki nerv xavf ostida:

1️⃣ Uzun ko'krak nervi (C5-C7, 'jannat qanotlari' - wings of heaven). Oldingi tishli mushakni innervatsiya qiladi. Lateral ko'krak arteriyasini bog'lashda yoki qo'ltiq limfa tugunlarini olib tashlashda shikastlanadi.
Natija: kurak suyagi ko'krak qafasiga yopishib turmaydi - 'qanotsimon kurak'. Bemor qo'lini gorizontaldan (90°) yuqori ko'tara olmaydi. Ko'pincha operatsiyadan bir necha hafta keyin seziladi. Yon tomondan pichoq jarohatlarida ham uchraydi.

2️⃣ Ko'krak-orqa (torakodorsal) nervi - orqaning eng keng mushagini innervatsiya qiladi. Shikastlansa - qo'lni orqaga uzatish va ichkariga burish kuchsizlanadi.

bandlar: Main muscle of inspiration; phrenic nerve C3-C5 ('C3, 4, 5 keeps the diaphragm alive')
Phrenic: motor + sensory (center); periphery sensory via intercostal nerves
Phrenic lesion: elevated hemidiaphragm, paradoxical movement
Referred pain: shoulder (C5) and trapezius ridge (C3-4)
T8: IVC + right phrenic; T10: esophagus + vagal trunks; T12: aorta, thoracic duct, azygos
postlar.izoh:
Diafragma - nafas olishning asosiy mushagi. U ko'krak qafasining vertikal, ko'ndalang va old-orqa o'lchamlarini oshiradi.

⚡️ Innervatsiya: diafragma nervi (C3-C5). U ham harakat, ham sezgi tolalarini beradi; diafragma chekkasining sezgisi esa qovurg'alararo nervlardan.

⚠️ Diafragma nervi shikastlansa, shu tomondagi gumbaz falajlanadi: nafas olganda pastga tushmaydi, aksincha qorin bosimi ta'sirida yuqoriga ko'tariladi (paradoksal harakat). Rentgenda gumbaz baland turadi.

Diafragma ta'sirlanganda og'riq yelkaga (C5) va trapetsiya mushagi qirrasiga (C3-4) uzatiladi.

🕳 Teshiklar - 'I ate (8) ten (10) eggs at twelve (12)':
• T8 - pastki kovak vena va o'ng diafragma nervi
• T10 - qizilo'ngach va adashgan nerv stvollari
• T12 - aorta, ko'krak limfa yo'li, toq vena

bandlar: External intercostals: elevate ribs (inspiration in exercise/disease)
Internal + innermost intercostals: forced expiration
Intercostal V-A-N: between internal and innermost, in costal groove (lower border of rib)
Ribs 1-6: 'pump handle' -> AP diameter; lower ribs: 'bucket handle' -> lateral diameter
Quiet expiration is passive; forced: abdominal wall muscles
postlar.izoh:
🫁 Nafas olish:
• Diafragma - asosiy mushak
• Tashqi qovurg'alararo mushaklar qovurg'alarni ko'taradi (jismoniy yuklama yoki o'pka kasalligida faol)
• Yordamchi mushaklar: to'sh-o'mrov-so'rg'ichsimon, katta va kichik ko'krak, narvonsimon mushaklar

Qovurg'alar harakati:
• 1-6 qovurg'alar - 'nasos dastasi': to'sh oldinga-yuqoriga suriladi, old-orqa o'lcham oshadi
• Pastki qovurg'alar - 'chelak dastasi': yonga-yuqoriga ko'tariladi, ko'ndalang o'lcham oshadi

😮‍💨 Nafas chiqarish odatda passiv - o'pka elastikligi hisobiga. Kuchli nafas chiqarishda ichki va eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar hamda qorin devori mushaklari (tashqi va ichki qiyshiq, ko'ndalang) ishlaydi.

📍 Qovurg'alararo vena, arteriya va nerv (yuqoridan pastga V-A-N) ichki va eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar orasida, qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasidagi egatda yotadi.

bandlar: Parietal pleura: costal, diaphragmatic, mediastinal, cervical (above 1st rib)
Visceral pleura covers lung, follows all fissures
Layers are continuous at the root (hilum) of the lung
Costal pleurisy: local chest wall pain via intercostal nerves
Mediastinal (and central diaphragmatic) pleura: referred to shoulder via phrenic (C3-5)
postlar.izoh:
Plevra - o'pkani o'rab turuvchi seroz parda, ikki varaqdan iborat:

🔹 Parietal plevra ko'krak qafasi devorini qoplaydi va joyiga qarab nomlanadi:
• qovurg'a plevrasi - qovurg'alar va oraliqlar ichki yuzasi
• diafragma plevrasi
• mediastinal plevra - ko'ks oralig'i tomonida
• bo'yin plevrasi - 1-qovurg'adan yuqorida, o'pka cho'qqisini qoplaydi

🔹 Visseral plevra o'pkaga mahkam yopishgan, barcha yoriqlarga kirib boradi. Ikkala varaq o'pka ildizida bir-biriga o'tadi.

⚠️ Plevrit (parietal plevra yallig'lanishi) nafas olganda o'tkir og'riq beradi:
• qovurg'a plevrasi -> qovurg'alararo nervlar orqali ko'krak devorida mahalliy og'riq
• mediastinal plevra -> diafragma nervi orqali yelkaga (C3-5) uzatilgan og'riq

bandlar: Air in pleural space: dyspnea, chest pain, hyperresonance, decreased breath sounds and fremitus
Primary spontaneous: apical bleb rupture; tall thin young male smokers
Secondary: emphysema bullae, Marfan, infection, ventilator barotrauma
Traumatic: rib fracture, gunshot, central line, lung biopsy
Tension: trachea deviates AWAY, hypotension, JVD -> immediate needle decompression + chest tube
postlar.izoh:
Pnevmotoraks - plevra bo'shlig'ida havo to'planishi. Zararlangan tomonda: hansirash, ko'krak og'rig'i, nafas harakatlarining notekisligi, perkussiyada timpanit, ovoz titrashi va nafas tovushlari susaygan.

Turlari:
• Birlamchi spontan - o'pka cho'qqisidagi subplevral pufakcha yorilishi. Ko'pincha baland bo'yli, ozg'in yosh erkaklarda, chekish bilan bog'liq.
• Ikkilamchi spontan - kasal o'pkada (emfizema bullalari, Marfan sindromi, infeksiyalar) yoki yuqori bosimli sun'iy ventilyatsiyada.
• Travmatik - qovurg'a sinishi, o'q jarohati yoki yatrogen (markaziy kateter, o'pka biopsiyasi).

🚨 Taranglashgan pnevmotoraks: havo kiradi, lekin chiqmaydi. Ko'ks oralig'i suriladi, pastki kovak vena bukiladi, venoz qaytish va yurak qon haydashi kamayadi -> obstruktiv shok (gipotenziya, taxikardiya, bo'yin venalari bo'rtishi). Traxeya sog' tomonga og'adi. Darhol igna dekompressiyasi, keyin plevra drenaji!

bandlar: Conducting: nose -> bronchi -> terminal bronchioles; anatomic dead space
Highest resistance: large-medium bronchi; least: terminal bronchioles (in parallel)
Cartilage and goblet cells end with bronchi; smooth muscle to terminal bronchioles
Pseudostratified ciliated columnar -> cuboidal at terminal bronchioles
Respiratory zone: respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveoli; cilia end in respiratory bronchioles
postlar.izoh:
Nafas yo'llari ikki zonaga bo'linadi:

🌬 O'tkazuvchi zona: burun, halqum, hiqildoq, traxeya, bronxlar, bronxiolalar va terminal bronxiolalar. Havoni isitadi, namlaydi va tozalaydi, lekin gaz almashinuvida qatnashmaydi - 'anatomik o'lik bo'shliq'.
• Havo yo'li qarshiligi eng katta - yirik va o'rta bronxlarda; eng kam - terminal bronxiolalarda, chunki ular juda ko'p va parallel joylashgan.
• Tog'ay va qadahsimon hujayralar bronxlar oxirigacha boradi.
• Ko'p qatorli kiprikli silindrsimon epiteliy terminal bronxiolalar boshigacha, keyin kubsimon epiteliy. Kiprikchalar shilliqni yuqoriga haydaydi - 'mukotsiliar eskalator'.
• Silliq mushak terminal bronxiolalar oxirigacha.

🫧 Respirator zona: respirator bronxiolalar, alveolyar yo'llar va alveolalar - gaz almashinuvi shu yerda. Kiprikchalar respirator bronxiolalarda tugaydi; alveolyar makrofaglar changni tozalaydi.

bandlar: Right lung: 3 lobes, horizontal + oblique fissures; left: 2 lobes + lingula
Oblique fissure: 5th ICS at midclavicular line -> 6th costal cartilage
Horizontal fissure: right 4th costal cartilage
Hilum: pulmonary artery RALS - Right Anterior, Left Superior to bronchus
Aspiration -> RIGHT lung: supine = superior segment RLL; right side = RUL; upright = RLL
postlar.izoh:
🫁 O'ng o'pka - 3 bo'lak (yuqori, o'rta, pastki), ularni gorizontal va qiyshiq yoriqlar ajratadi. Chap o'pka - 2 bo'lak va qiyshiq yoriq; o'rta bo'lak o'rnida yurak joylashgan, uning o'xshashi - lingula.

📍 Yoriqlar proyeksiyasi:
• Qiyshiq yoriq - o'rta o'mrov chizig'ida 5-qovurg'alararo oraliq, medialda 6-qovurg'a tog'ayi ortida tugaydi
• Gorizontal yoriq - o'ng 5-oraliqdagi qiyshiq yoriqdan o'ng 4-qovurg'a tog'ayigacha

O'pka darvozasida o'pka arteriyasi bronxga nisbatan: RALS - o'ngda oldinda, chapda yuqorida. Karina ko'tariluvchi aorta ortida.

🥜 Yot jism ko'pincha O'NG o'pkaga tushadi: o'ng bosh bronx kengroq, tikroq va kaltaroq.
• chalqancha yotganda - o'ng pastki bo'lakning yuqori segmenti
• o'ng yonboshda - o'ng yuqori bo'lak
• tik turganda - o'ng pastki bo'lak

bandlar: Type I pneumocytes: squamous, 97% of surface, gas exchange
Type II: cuboidal; make surfactant (DPPC) from lamellar bodies; stem cells for type I and II
Surfactant lowers surface tension; collapsing pressure = 2T/r (Laplace)
Alveolar macrophages: 'dust cells', 'heart failure cells' (hemosiderin)
NRDS: prematurity, maternal diabetes, C-section; L/S ratio < 1.5; give maternal steroids
postlar.izoh:
🫧 Alveola hujayralari:
• I tip pnevmotsitlar - yassi, alveola yuzasining 97% ini qoplaydi, gaz almashinuvi uchun.
• II tip pnevmotsitlar - kubsimon. Ular surfaktant (asosan dipalmitoilfosfatidilxolin) ishlab chiqaradi va zararlanishda I va II tip hujayralarga aylanuvchi o'zak hujayra vazifasini bajaradi.
• Alveolyar makrofaglar - 'chang hujayralari'; yurak yetishmovchiligida gemosiderinli 'yurak nuqsoni hujayralari'.
Kon teshikchalari alveolalarni bir-biriga bog'laydi (pnevmoniyada bakteriyalar ham shu yo'l bilan tarqaladi).

Surfaktant sirt tarangligini kamaytiradi va alveolalarni yopishib qolishdan saqlaydi. Laplas qonuni: yopilish bosimi = 2 x taranglik / radius. Surfaktant ~20-haftadan hosil bo'la boshlaydi, ~35-haftada yetarli bo'ladi.

👶 Chaqaloqlar RDS: surfaktant yetishmasligi, rentgenda 'xira oyna'. Xavf: chala tug'ilish, onadagi diabet, kesarcha kesish. L/S nisbati < 1.5. Davolash: tug'ruqdan oldin onaga glyukokortikoid, chaqaloqqa surfaktant. Kislorod asoratlari - RIB: retinopatiya, qorinchaga qon quyilish, bronxopulmonal displaziya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 52-year-old woman notices a painless lump in her left breast. On examination there is a firm 3-cm mass in the upper outer quadrant, and the overlying skin is retracted and dimpled, resembling orange peel.
savollar.savol: Involvement of which structures best explains the skin dimpling?
savollar.izoh: O'sma Kuper (osuvchi) boylamlarini tortadi -> teri botadi, 'apelsin po'sti'. Kuper boylamlari bezni teriga va chuqur fassiyaga bog'laydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 47-year-old woman has a biopsy-proven carcinoma in the upper medial quadrant of the right breast. Axillary lymph nodes are clinically negative.
savollar.savol: Which lymph nodes are most likely to receive the earliest metastases from this tumor?
savollar.izoh: Medial kvadrant limfasi asosan parasternal tugunlarga (ichki ko'krak tomirlari bo'ylab) boradi. Shu yo'l orqali saraton qarama-qarshi sut beziga ham o'tadi.

savollar.vinyetka: Three weeks after a modified radical mastectomy with axillary node dissection, a 55-year-old woman cannot raise her arm above shoulder level. When she pushes against a wall, the medial border of her scapula protrudes posteriorly.
savollar.savol: Which nerve was most likely injured during surgery?
savollar.izoh: Qanotsimon kurak = uzun ko'krak nervi (C5-C7) -> oldingi tishli mushak. Lateral ko'krak arteriyasini bog'lashda shikastlanadi; qo'l 90° dan yuqori ko'tarilmaydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man develops a right subphrenic abscess after an appendectomy. In addition to fever and right upper quadrant pain, he complains of pain at the tip of his right shoulder.
savollar.savol: The shoulder pain is carried by sensory fibers of which spinal cord segments?
savollar.izoh: Diafragma markaziy qismining sezgisi diafragma nervi (C3-C5) orqali. Shuning uchun og'riq shu segmentlarning teri sohasi - yelkaga uzatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During an anatomy session, students trace the structures passing through the diaphragm. One opening lies at the level of the T8 vertebra within the central tendon.
savollar.savol: Which structures pass through this opening?
javoblar: Inferior vena cava and right phrenic nerve
Aorta, thoracic duct and azygos vein
savollar.izoh: 'I ate (8) ten (10) eggs at twelve (12)': T8 - pastki kovak vena (+ o'ng diafragma nervi), T10 - qizilo'ngach va vagus, T12 - aorta, ko'krak limfa yo'li, toq vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old man is stabbed in the right chest. The knife entered the intercostal space immediately below the inferior border of the 6th rib and passed deep to the internal intercostal muscle.
savollar.savol: Which structures are most at risk at this location?
savollar.izoh: Qovurg'alararo vena, arteriya va nerv (V-A-N) qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasidagi egatda, ichki va eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar orasida yotadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 24-year-old man with right lower lobe pneumonia has sharp, localized pain over the right lateral chest wall that worsens with each deep breath.
savollar.savol: This pain is transmitted by which nerves?
savollar.izoh: Qovurg'a (kostal) plevrasi qovurg'alararo nervlar bilan innervatsiya qilinadi -> devorda mahalliy og'riq. Mediastinal plevra og'rig'i diafragma nervi orqali yelkaga uzatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man is brought in after a motorcycle crash. He is dyspneic, BP 78/40, HR 132, with distended neck veins. Breath sounds are absent on the left, and the trachea is shifted to the right.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate immediate step?
javoblar: Needle decompression of the left chest
savollar.izoh: Taranglashgan pnevmotoraks - klinik tashxis: traxeya sog' tomonga og'gan, gipotenziya, venalar bo'rtgan. Rentgen kutilmaydi, darhol igna dekompressiyasi, keyin drenaj.

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old bedridden man with dysphagia after a stroke develops fever and cough. He has been lying supine most of the day. Chest imaging shows a new infiltrate consistent with aspiration pneumonia.
savollar.savol: Which lung segment is most likely involved?
javoblar: Superior segment of the right lower lobe
Apical segment of the left upper lobe
Basal segments of the left lower lobe
savollar.izoh: Aspiratsiya ko'pincha o'ng o'pkaga (o'ng bosh bronx kengroq, tikroq, kaltaroq). Chalqancha yotganda - o'ng pastki bo'lakning yuqori segmenti.

savollar.vinyetka: A boy born at 29 weeks of gestation to a mother with poorly controlled diabetes develops grunting, nasal flaring and retractions within hours of birth. Chest X-ray shows diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities.
savollar.savol: Deficient function of which cell type is the primary cause?
savollar.izoh: Chaqaloqlar RDS: II tip pnevmotsitlar surfaktantni yetarli ishlab chiqarmaydi. Chala tug'ilish va onadagi diabet (homila insulini) xavfni oshiradi. L/S < 1.5.

bandlar: Purpose: sample pleural fluid or drain blood/pus
Site: 9th intercostal space, midaxillary line, during expiration
Needle just ABOVE the upper border of rib 10 (avoid V-A-N under rib 9)
Layers: skin -> superficial fascia -> external, internal, innermost intercostals -> parietal pleura
postlar.izoh:
Torakosentez - plevra bo'shlig'idan suyuqlik olish (tahlil uchun) yoki qon/yiringni chiqarish.

📍 Joyi: o'rta qo'ltiq chizig'ida 9-qovurg'alararo oraliq, nafas chiqarish paytida - o'pkaning pastki chegarasini shikastlamaslik uchun.

⚡️ Asosiy qoida: igna pastdagi qovurg'aning (10-qovurg'a) YUQORI qirrasi bo'ylab, biroz yuqoriga qiyalatib kiritiladi. Chunki qovurg'alararo vena, arteriya va nerv yuqoridagi qovurg'aning pastki qirrasi ostida yotadi.

💉 Igna o'tadigan qavatlar:
teri -> yuza fassiya -> tashqi qovurg'alararo mushak -> ichki qovurg'alararo mushak -> eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushak -> parietal plevra

bandlar: Indication: pain of rib fracture or herpes zoster (shingles)
Needle at the posterior angle of the rib, along its LOWER border
Collateral branches of the nerve must also be bathed
Layers: skin -> superficial fascia -> serratus anterior -> external -> internal intercostal
Several adjacent nerves blocked: dermatomes overlap
postlar.izoh:
Qovurg'alararo nerv blokadasi qovurg'a sinishi yoki o'rab oluvchi temiratki (herpes zoster) og'rig'ini qoldirish uchun qilinadi.

📍 Igna qovurg'aning orqa burchagida, uning PASTKI qirrasi bo'ylab kiritiladi - nerv shu yerda egatda yotadi va anestetik uni 'yuvadi'. Nervning kollateral tarmoqlari ham anesteziya qilinishi kerak.

💉 Qavatlar: teri -> yuza fassiya -> oldingi tishli mushak -> tashqi qovurg'alararo -> ichki qovurg'alararo mushak.

💡 Bitta emas, bir nechta qo'shni nervlar blokada qilinadi, chunki qo'shni dermatomlar bir-birini qoplaydi.

Torakosentez bilan farqni eslab qoling: torakosentezda igna qovurg'aning YUQORI qirrasidan (tomirlardan qochish), blokadada esa PASTKI qirrasidan (nervga yetish).

bandlar: Compression of lower trunk of brachial plexus (C8-T1) +/- subclavian vessels
Usually within the scalene triangle
Causes: cervical (anomalous first) rib, Pancoast tumor
Atrophy of thenar, hypothenar and interossei; medial forearm/hand numbness (like Klumpke)
Weak radial pulse when head turned to opposite side, subclavian bruit
postlar.izoh:
Ko'krak qafasi chiqish sindromi - yelka chigalining pastki stvoli (C8-T1) va/yoki o'mrov osti tomirlarining ezilishi, ko'pincha narvonsimon mushaklar uchburchagida.

Sabablari: qo'shimcha bo'yin qovurg'asi yoki anomal 1-qovurg'a, Pankost o'smasi.

🖐 Nerv belgilari (Klumpke falajiga o'xshash):
• tenar va gipotenar tepaliklar, suyaklararo mushaklar atrofiyasi
• bilak va qo'l panjasining medial tomonida sezgi buzilishi

🩸 Tomir belgilari: ishemiya, og'riq, shish; boshni qarama-qarshi tomonga burganda bilak arteriyasi pulsi susayadi, o'mrov osti arteriyasi ustida shovqin. Qo'llarni ko'targan holda angiografiyada o'mrov osti arteriyasida qisman torayish ko'rinadi.

bandlar: PA view right border: SVC/azygos above, right atrium below
PA view left border: aortic knob -> left pulmonary artery -> left ventricle
Also on PA: trachea, right and left main bronchi, right inferior pulmonary vein
Lateral view: ascending aorta and pulmonary outflow tract in front
Lateral view: aortic arch, upper lobe bronchi, confluence of pulmonary veins
postlar.izoh:
Ko'krak qafasi rentgenogrammasida tuzilmalarni tanib olish USMLE rasmli savollarida tez-tez kerak bo'ladi.

🩻 To'g'ri (PA) proyeksiya:
• O'ng chegara: yuqorida yuqori kovak vena / toq vena, pastda O'NG BO'LMACHA
• Chap chegara: yuqoridan pastga - aorta ravog'i ('aorta tugmasi'), chap o'pka arteriyasi, CHAP QORINCHA
• Markazda: traxeya, o'ng va chap bosh bronxlar; o'ng o'pka arteriyasi va uning yuqori bo'lak tarmog'i, o'ng pastki o'pka venasi

🩻 Yon proyeksiya:
• oldinda - o'pka ustuni chiqish yo'li va ko'tariluvchi aorta
• aorta ravog'i va undan chiquvchi yelka-bosh tomirlari
• traxeya, o'ng va chap yuqori bo'lak bronxlari
• o'ng va chap o'pka arteriyalari, o'pka venalarining qo'shilish joyi

💡 Esda tuting: o'ng yurak chegarasi = o'ng bo'lmacha, chap chegara = chap qorincha.

bandlar: Superior meatus: posterior ethmoid; middle: frontal, maxillary, anterior ethmoid; inferior: nasolacrimal duct
Maxillary sinus most affected: ostium superomedial, drains against gravity
Viral first; bacterial: nontypeable H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, M. catarrhalis
Anterior epistaxis (most common): Kiesselbach plexus - 'LEGS'
Posterior (life-threatening): sphenopalatine artery; angiofibroma in adolescent males
postlar.izoh:
👃 Rinosinusit - bo'shliq teshigi berkilib, suyuqlik to'planadi va yallig'lanadi.
• Yuqori burun yo'li - orqa g'alvirsimon katakchalar
• O'rta yo'l - peshona, yuqori jag' va oldingi g'alvirsimon bo'shliqlar
• Pastki yo'l - burun-ko'z yosh kanali
Yuqori jag' bo'shlig'i eng ko'p zararlanadi: teshigi yuqori-medialda, suyuqlik og'irlik kuchiga qarshi oqadi. Avval virus (rinovirus), keyin bakteriya: tiplanmaydigan H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, M. catarrhalis. Asoratlar: ko'z kosasi flegmonasi, kavernoz sinus sindromi, meningit.

🩸 Burundan qon ketish:
• Ko'pincha oldingi qismdan - Kisselbax chigali. Eslab qolish 'Kiesselbach drives his Lexus with his LEGS': yuqori Lab, oldingi va orqa Ethmoidal, katta tanglay (Greater palatine), Sfenopalatin arteriyalari.
• Hayot uchun xavfli - orqa qismdan, sfenopalatin arteriyasidan (yuqori jag' arteriyasi tarmog'i).
Sabablar: yot jism, travma, allergik rinit; o'smir o'g'il bolalarda - burun-halqum angiofibromasi.

bandlar: Trachea: pseudostratified ciliated columnar + goblet cells; 16-20 C-shaped cartilages; seromucous glands
Trachea: smooth muscle bridges open ends of the C-rings
Bronchi: irregular cartilage plates, fewer glands, prominent smooth muscle
Bronchioles: no cartilage, no glands; highest proportion of smooth muscle; club cells
Lung endothelium makes ACE (angiotensin I -> II)
postlar.izoh:
O'pka tashqi muhitga ochiq, shuning uchun ifloslanish va infeksiyalarga sezgir. U butun yurak qon haydashini qabul qiladi va qon tarkibini o'zgartiradi: o'pka endoteliysi angiotenzin I ni II ga aylantiruvchi fermentni (APF) ishlab chiqaradi.

🔬 Gistologik farqlar:

Traxeya: ko'p qatorli kiprikli silindrsimon epiteliy + qadahsimon hujayralar; 16-20 ta C-shaklidagi tog'ay halqalar; seroz-shilliq bezlar; silliq mushak halqalarning ochiq uchlari orasida.

Bronxlar: epiteliy asta-sekin oddiy silindrsimonga o'tadi; tog'ay notekis plastinkalar; bezlar kamroq; silliq mushak yaxshi rivojlangan.

Bronxiolalar: kiprikli hujayralar, kam qadahsimon hujayra, terminal bronxiolalarda klub hujayralari. Tog'ay ham, bez ham YO'Q. Bronx daraxtida silliq mushak ulushi eng yuqori (astmada bronxospazmning sababi!). Elastik tolalar ko'p.

bandlar: Ciliated columnar: 200-300 cilia each -> mucociliary escalator
Goblet cells + submucosal glands: mucus traps dust, microbes, soluble gases
Basal cells: stem cells; with neuroendocrine cells give 'pseudostratified' look
Neuroendocrine (Kulchitsky, APUD) cells at branch points; brush cells may be sensory
Club cells: nonciliated, CYP450 detox, surfactant component, progenitors; smoking -> reversible squamous metaplasia
postlar.izoh:
Traxeya epiteliysi hujayralari:

• Kiprikli silindrsimon hujayralar - har birida 200-300 kiprik. Ular shilliq qavatni halqum tomon haydaydi, u yerda yutib yuboriladi - 'mukotsiliar eskalator'.
• Qadahsimon hujayralar va shilliq osti bezlari shilliq ishlab chiqaradi. U chang, bakteriya, viruslarni ushlaydi va ozon, oltingugurt dioksidi kabi zararli gazlarni yutadi.
• Bazal hujayralar - kiprikli va qadahsimon hujayralarning o'zak hujayralari. Ular bo'shliqqa yetmaydi, shuning uchun epiteliy 'ko'p qatorli' ko'rinadi.
• Neyroendokrin (Kulchitskiy, APUD) hujayralar - tarmoqlanish joylarida guruh bo'lib joylashadi.
• Cho'tkasimon hujayralar - sezuvchi retseptor bo'lishi mumkin.
• Klub hujayralari (bronxiolalarda) - kipriksiz, sekretor donachali; toksinlarni CYP450 orqali parchalaydi, surfaktant komponentini ajratadi, o'zak hujayra vazifasini bajaradi.

🚬 Chekishda kiprikli epiteliy yassi epiteliyga aylanadi - yassi hujayrali metaplaziya. Bu jarayon qaytar. Tozalash mexanizmi buzilsa - infeksiya yoki pnevmokonioz.

bandlar: AR; CFTR gene on chr 7; most often deltaF508 -> misfolded protein, not at membrane
Less Cl- (and water) secretion, more Na+ reabsorption via ENaC -> thick mucus
High sweat Cl- (pilocarpine test); newborn screen: high immunoreactive trypsinogen
S. aureus in childhood, P. aeruginosa in adults; pancreatic insufficiency, meconium ileus, male infertility
Rx: DNase, hypertonic saline, azithromycin, pancrelipase; potentiator ivacaftor, correctors lumacaftor/tezacaftor
postlar.izoh:
🧬 Mukovissidoz - autosom retsessiv; 7-xromosomadagi CFTR geni. Ko'pincha deltaF508 deletsiyasi: oqsil noto'g'ri buklanadi va hujayra membranasiga yetib bormaydi.

Mexanizm: CFTR - ATF bilan ochiladigan Cl- kanali (o'pka va ichakda Cl- chiqaradi, ter bezida qayta so'radi). Cl- va suv chiqishi kamayadi, Na+ ENaC orqali ko'proq so'riladi -> shilliq quyuq bo'ladi. Ter testida Cl- yuqori. Chaqaloqlar skriningida immunoreaktiv tripsinogen oshgan.

🫁 Klinika: takroriy infeksiyalar (bolalikda S. aureus, kattalarda P. aeruginosa, ABPA), bronxoektazlar, burun poliplari, barmoqlar 'baraban tayoqchasi'; me'da osti bezi yetishmovchiligi, steatoreya, A, D, E, K yetishmasligi, mukovissidozli diabet; yangi tug'ilganda mekoniy ileus; erkaklarda bepushtlik (urug' yo'li yo'q).

💊 Davolash: fizioterapiya, dornaza alfa, gipertonik eritma ingalyatsiyasi, azitromitsin, ibuprofen, pankrelipaza; CFTR modulyatorlari - potensiator (ivakaftor) va korrektorlar (lumakaftor, tezakaftor).

❤️ Yurak bo'shliqlarining joylashuvi:

• Chap bo'lmacha - yurakning eng ORQA qismi. U kattalashsa (masalan, mitral stenozda) qizilo'ngachni ezib, yutish qiyinlashadi yoki chap qaytuvchi hiqildoq nervini (adashgan nerv tarmog'i) ezib, ovoz bo'g'iladi - Ortner sindromi.

1. Fibroz perikard
2. Parietal perikard
3. Epikard (visseral perikard)
Perikard bo'shlig'i parietal perikard va epikard orasida.

Perikard diafragma nervi bilan innervatsiya qilinadi, shuning uchun perikardit og'rig'i bo'yin, qo'llar yoki yelkaga (ko'pincha chapga) uzatiladi.

🫀 Toj arteriyalari:

• Oldingi qorinchalararo arteriya (LAD) - qorinchalararo to'siqning old 2/3 qismi, old-lateral so'rg'ichsimon mushak va chap qorincha old devori. Eng ko'p tiqiladigan arteriya.
• Orqa qorinchalararo arteriya (PDA) - to'siqning orqa 1/3 qismi, qorinchalar orqa devorlari va orqa-medial so'rg'ichsimon mushak.
• O'ng toj arteriyasi (RCA) - sinus-bo'lmacha (SA) va bo'lmacha-qorincha (AV) tugunlarini qon bilan ta'minlaydi. Shuning uchun pastki infarktda bradikardiya va blokada bo'ladi. O'tkir chekka tarmog'i - o'ng qorinchaga.

• o'ng dominant (eng ko'p) - RCA dan
• chap dominant - aylanma arteriyadan (LCX)
• kodominant - ikkalasidan

💡 Chap qorincha va to'siqqa qon oqimi diastola boshida eng yuqori. Toj sinus chap AV egatida yotadi va o'ng bo'lmachaga quyiladi.

Along the lower border of the 10th rib

Upper trunk of the brachial plexus and vertebral artery

It is invasive squamous cell carcinoma
It results from loss of club cells only
savollar.izoh: Chekish ko'p qatorli kiprikli epiteliyni yassi epiteliyga aylantiradi - yassi hujayrali metaplaziya. Bu himoya moslashuvi va chekish tashlansa qaytadi.

javoblar: Misfolded CFTR protein fails to reach the cell membrane
CFTR channel reaches the membrane but cannot open

savollar.izoh: O'ng toj arteriyasi ko'pchilikda SA va AV tugunlarini ta'minlaydi va PDA ni beradi (o'ng dominantlik). Pastki infarktda bradikardiya va AV blokada shu sababli.

Superficial ring: superolateral to pubic tubercle

🔹 Chuqur (ichki) halqa - kanalga kirish joyi. Pastki epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA, chov boylamining o'rtasidan sal yuqorida.
🔹 Yuza (tashqi) halqa - kanalning medial chiqish teshigi, qov do'mbog'idan yuqori-lateralda.

• Moyak arteriyasi - qorin aortasidan
• Pampinform venoz chigal - moyakni sovutib, haroratini boshqaradi; chuqur halqada moyak venasiga qo'shiladi
• Urug' yo'li va uning arteriyasi
• Vegetativ nervlar va limfa tomirlari

⚠️ Muhim: moyak limfasi bel (aorta yoni) limfa tugunlariga boradi, yuza chov tugunlariga EMAS (oraliqning qolgan qismidan farqli). Moyak saratoni metastazi shuni hisobga olib izlanadi.

🔨 Kremaster refleksi: sonning yuqori-ichki yuzasiga yengil tegilganda moyak biroz ko'tariladi.
• Sezuvchi yo'l - yonbosh-chov nervining L1 tolalari
• Harakat yo'li - son-jinsiy nervning jinsiy tarmog'i (kremaster mushagi)

Diagnose Spigelian hernia with ultrasound or CT

Ko'pincha qorin pastki qismida, chunki u yerda to'g'ri mushakning orqa qini yo'q. Belgilari: qorin og'rig'i, shu chiziq bo'ylab qo'lga unnaydigan bo'rtma. Tashxis - UTT va KT.

🔸 Diafragma churrasi - qorin a'zolari ko'krak qafasiga chiqadi; ko'krakda ichak shovqinlari eshitiladi.

Hiatal churra turlari:
• Sirpanuvchi - me'da-qizilo'ngach tutashuvi yuqoriga siljiydi, 'qum soatisimon me'da'. Eng ko'p uchraydi, GERK bilan bog'liq.

🔹 Kichik charvi xaltasi (omental bursa) - me'da embrional davrda soat yo'nalishida 90° burilishi natijasida hosil bo'ladi. Katta qorin parda bo'shlig'i bilan charvi (Vinslov) teshigi orqali tutashadi.

💧 Suyuqlik harakati:
• Normada qorin parda suyuqligi ko'tariluvchi va tushuvchi chambar ichak yonidagi ariqchalar bo'ylab diafragma ostiga ko'tariladi va diafragma limfa tomirlariga so'riladi.

• Chalqancha yotganda - yuqoriga, diafragma osti va jigar-buyrak chuqurchasiga oqadi. Jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi bu holatda eng past nuqta. Diafragma nervi (C3-C5) ta'sirlanib, yelka og'rig'i paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

Hepatoduodenal: portal triad (proper hepatic a., portal v., CBD); Pringle maneuver
Hepatogastric: lesser curvature, gastric vessels (lesser omentum + hepatoduodenal)

Qorin bo'shlig'i boylamlari:

🔹 Ventral tutqichdan:
• O'roqsimon boylam - jigardan qorin old devoriga. Ichida jigarning yumaloq boylami (homila kindik venasining qoldig'i) va kindik oldi venalari.
• Jigar-o'n ikki barmoqli ichak boylami - ichida portal triada: xususiy jigar arteriyasi, darvoza venasi, umumiy o't yo'li. Charvi teshigining old chegarasi. Pringl manyovri: shu boylam qisiladi - qon to'xtasa manba darvoza venasi/jigar arteriyasi, to'xtamasa jigar venalari yoki pastki kovak vena.
• Jigar-me'da boylami - me'daning kichik egriligiga, me'da tomirlari bilan. O'ngda katta va kichik xaltalarni ajratadi; kichik xaltaga kirish uchun kesiladi.
Bu ikkalasi birga - kichik charvi.

🔹 Dorsal tutqichdan (katta charvi):

• Me'da-taloq boylami - qisqa me'da arteriyalari va chap me'da-charvi tomirlari; chapda xaltalarni ajratadi
• Taloq-buyrak boylami - taloq arteriyasi va venasi, me'da osti bezi dumi

Duodenum: Brunner glands (HCO3-); jejunum: tall plicae, 'feathered'

🧱 Ichak devori qavatlari (ichkaridan tashqariga - MSMS):
• Shilliq qavat - epiteliy, xususiy plastinka, shilliq qavat mushagi
• Shilliq osti qavat - Meysner nerv chigali (sekretsiya)
• Mushak qavati - Auerbax nerv chigali (motorika)
• Seroz qavat (intraperitoneal a'zolarda) yoki adventitsiya (retroperitonealda)
Eroziya faqat shilliq qavatda; yara shilliq osti va mushak qavatlarigacha chuqurlashadi.

Sekin to'lqinlar Kaxal hujayralaridan: o'n ikki barmoqli ichak > yonbosh ichak > me'da.

🔬 Gistologiya:
• Qizilo'ngach - muguzlanmaydigan ko'p qavatli yassi epiteliy; yuqori 1/3 ko'ndalang-targ'il, pastki 2/3 silliq mushak
• Me'da - parietal hujayralar pushti (eozinofil), bosh hujayralar ko'k (bazofil)
• O'n ikki barmoqli ichak - vorsinkalar, shilliq osti qavatdagi Brunner bezlari (bikarbonat), Liberkyun kriptalari (o'zak hujayralar va defensin, lizotsim ajratuvchi Paneth hujayralari)
• Och ichak - baland, ko'p burmalar, kontrastda 'pat' ko'rinishi
• Yonbosh ichak - Peyer pilakchalari, qadahsimon hujayralar eng ko'p
• Yo'g'on ichak - kriptalar va ko'p qadahsimon hujayralar, vorsinkalar YO'Q

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-month-old boy has an intermittent bulge in the right groin that extends into the scrotum when he cries. At surgery, the hernia sac is found entering the inguinal canal lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Failure of which embryologic process caused this hernia?
savollar.izoh: Qiyshiq chov churrasi: qin o'simtasi yopilmagan, chuqur halqa orqali epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA kiradi va yorg'oqqa tushadi. Gidrotsele ham shu sababdan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old man with chronic constipation and benign prostatic hyperplasia has a groin bulge that appears on straining and disappears when he lies down. At surgery the bulge is medial to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Weakness of which structure is the main cause?
javoblar: Transversalis fascia in the Hesselbach triangle
savollar.izoh: To'g'ri chov churrasi: Hesselbax uchburchagida ko'ndalang fassiya zaiflashadi, epigastral tomirlardan MEDIALDA. Keksa erkaklar, kuchanish (qabziyat, BPH).

savollar.vinyetka: A 65-year-old woman has a painful, tender, irreducible lump in the right groin with vomiting. The mass lies below the inguinal ligament and lateral to the pubic tubercle.
savollar.savol: Through which space did this hernia most likely pass?
javoblar: Femoral canal, medial to the femoral vein
savollar.izoh: Son churrasi: son kanali orqali, chov boylamidan pastda, son venasidan medialda. Ayollarda ko'proq va qisilish xavfi eng yuqori - shoshilinch operatsiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man is diagnosed with a seminoma of the left testis. Staging CT is ordered to look for lymph node metastases.
savollar.savol: Which lymph nodes are the first to be involved?
savollar.izoh: Moyak limfasi moyak tomirlari bo'ylab bel (aorta yoni) tugunlariga boradi. Yorg'oq terisi esa yuza chov tugunlariga - farqini eslab qoling.

savollar.vinyetka: After an open inguinal hernia repair, a 35-year-old man is found to have absent elevation of the testis when the skin of his upper medial thigh is stroked. Sensation over the thigh is normal.
savollar.savol: Injury to which nerve best explains this finding?
javoblar: Genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve
savollar.izoh: Kremaster refleksi: sezuvchi - yonbosh-chov nervi (L1), harakat - son-jinsiy nervning jinsiy tarmog'i. Sezgi saqlangan, javob yo'q -> harakat tarmog'i shikastlangan.

savollar.vinyetka: A full-term newborn develops severe respiratory distress immediately after birth. The abdomen is scaphoid, and bowel sounds are heard over the left hemithorax. Chest X-ray shows bowel loops in the left chest with mediastinal shift to the right.
savollar.savol: Which embryologic defect is most likely responsible?
javoblar: Incomplete closure of the pleuroperitoneal membrane
Failure of the septum transversum to form the central tendon only
savollar.izoh: Tug'ma diafragma churrasi: plevra-qorinparda membranasi yopilmagan, ko'pincha CHAPda (o'ngni jigar himoyalaydi). Qorin 'botiq', o'pka gipoplaziyasi xavfi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old obese woman has chronic heartburn and regurgitation. Barium swallow shows the gastroesophageal junction located above the diaphragm, with an 'hourglass' configuration of the stomach.
savollar.savol: What type of hernia is present?
savollar.izoh: Sirpanuvchi hiatal churra: me'da-qizilo'ngach tutashuvi diafragmadan yuqoriga siljiydi, 'qum soati' ko'rinishi, GERK. Paraezofagealda tutashuv joyida qoladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During laparotomy for a liver laceration after a car crash, the surgeon places a vascular clamp across the free edge of the lesser omentum at the omental foramen to control bleeding.
savollar.savol: Which structures are compressed by this maneuver?
javoblar: Proper hepatic artery, portal vein and common bile duct
Hepatic veins and inferior vena cava
savollar.izoh: Pringl manyovri: jigar-o'n ikki barmoqli ichak boylami (portal triada) qisiladi. Qon ketish davom etsa, manba jigar venalari yoki pastki kovak vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man with a perforated duodenal ulcer has been lying flat in bed for several hours. He develops generalized peritonitis.
savollar.savol: In this position, where does peritoneal fluid tend to collect at the lowest point of the peritoneal cavity?
savollar.izoh: Chalqancha yotganda eng past nuqta - jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi. Tik turganda suyuqlik erkaklarda to'g'ri ichak-qovuq, ayollarda to'g'ri ichak-bachadon cho'ntagiga oqadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A pathology resident examines a biopsy from the small intestine. It shows villi on the surface and coiled bicarbonate-secreting mucous glands located in the submucosa.
savollar.savol: From which part of the GI tract was the biopsy most likely taken?
savollar.izoh: Shilliq osti qavatdagi Brunner bezlari (bikarbonat) faqat o'n ikki barmoqli ichakda. Yonbosh ichakda - Peyer pilakchalari, yo'g'on ichakda vorsinka yo'q.
